description: This file is a server-side route handler for managing recurring invoice data in a SvelteKit application. It provides functions to load data from APIs, handle form actions for creating, updating, deleting, and toggling the status of recurring invoices. The file integrates with Django backend endpoints and maps raw data into frontend-friendly structures. It is specific to recurring invoices and their related API interactions.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches recurring invoices and accounts based on URL parameters, processes and transforms the data into frontend structure, and returns it for page rendering.

methods.name: actions.create
methods.description: Handles form submission to create a new recurring invoice via API call.

methods.name: actions.update
methods.description: Handles form submission to update an existing recurring invoice identified by ID.

methods.name: actions.delete
methods.description: Handles form submission to delete a specific recurring invoice.

methods.name: actions.toggle
methods.description: Toggles the active status of a recurring invoice.
